description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Free Action (1 scrap): You leave grease in any spaces you enter this turn. Grease lasts 1 minute or until removed and is Slowed Terrain. Creatures that enter a greased space must succeed a DEX save or fall Prone.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Affects all spaces adjacent to you.

Passive: You ignore Slowed Terrain you create.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Posts a DEX save (fail: Prone) — use its save button when a creature enters a greased space.

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Slick Shoes (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Slick Shoes" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Grease every space you enter this turn (Slowed Terrain, 1 minute).
